title: Appearance
themeDescription: Choose the colors of the workspace. Priority labels keep their own fixed colors.
customThemeDescription: Build your own brand direction. The secondary surfaces are derived from these two colors.
animationsDescription: Pick how lively buttons, inputs, cards and labels feel.

levelDescriptions.fluid: Smooth lifts, springs and focus halos.
levelDescriptions.fantastic: Maximal motion: fire, shimmer, floating badges and an aurora background.

effectsDescription: Toggle the individual effects the whole company gets.

hoverLift.name: Hover lift
hoverLift.description: Buttons and fields rise slightly under the pointer.

hoverGlow.name: Hover glow
hoverGlow.description: A colored halo follows the cursor on buttons and focus.

pressRipple.name: Press ripple
pressRipple.description: A soft circle expands from the click point.

pressBounce.name: Press bounce
pressBounce.description: Buttons squash and spring back when clicked.

shineSweep.name: Shine sweep
shineSweep.description: A diagonal highlight crosses buttons on hover.

floatBadges.name: Floating badges
floatBadges.description: Priority labels gently bob up and down.

priorityFire.name: Urgent fire
priorityFire.description: Urgent labels burn with animated flames at the Fantastic level.

ambientGlow.name: Aurora background
ambientGlow.description: Slow moving brand-colored glows behind the whole app at the Fantastic level.

previewDescription: Hover, click and type in the sample below before saving.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change the workspace appearance.
userDescription: These preferences only apply to your account, not to the whole company.
colorModeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your operating system.
highContrastDescription: Stronger borders, text and solid priority chips for better readability.
reduceMotionDescription: Turns off every animation and transition on your account, including company effects.
currentWorkspaceLook: Your company uses the {theme} theme with {level} animations.
